ei.title: Percentages of U.S. Teenagers Who Spent Time with Friends by Communication Type
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The graph above shows the percentages of U.S. teenagers who spent time with friends by communication type, based on a survey conducted between 2014 and 2015. In the category of Every Day, text messaging showed the highest percentage among the four types of communication that teenagers used to spend time with friends. In the category of Less Often, the percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone was more than twice that of teenagers who did so through text messaging. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through talking on the phone in the category of Every Day was lower than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Less Often. In the category of Less Often, emailing was the second highest in percentage among the types of communication listed above. The percentage of teenagers who spent time with friends through video chatting in the category of Less Often was higher than that of teenagers who did so in the category of Every Day.
